newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CABINET PARTIES SAY SUPPORT GOVERNMENT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CABINET PARTIES SAY SUPPORT GOVERNMENT.

text.p: The Finnish government is set to win a vote of confidence scheduled for Friday (1300/1000 GMT), according to the official speeches of the coalition parties' parliamentary groups on Wednesday.
The parliamentary group speakers of each of the five cabinet parties said their groups supported the government's policies.
The coalition parties have 142 seats in the 200-strong legislature where the Speaker does not vote.
Their views were presented during a parliamentary debate initiated by an interpellation by the opposition Centre Party one month before municipal and European Parliament elections.
The main topics of the interpellation debate were economic policy and unemployment.

Delivering the government's response, Social Democratic Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said the Finnish economy was heading for better times and he repeated that Finland will meet next year the criteria for the third stage of EMU.
